the south bay's round-headed light in the second storey under its keyed hood (x 55-150 px), and the principal storey's light under it behind the veranda

the mansard's round-headed dormer over the south bay and the tall stack over the deck behind it
the veranda's height and floor: its flat roof about y 700 px and its floor about y 1115, on open piers to grade, at the print's

the veranda's south run (T-3666 sign-off): its floor on open square piers under each column where it stood on a solid podium, its balustrade at the deck between the pedestals, its roof flat and bare (liberty L-k01-2109-roloson-3666 revised)

the rear block's step (T-3666 sign-off): brought in from the sheet's 2.32 m to about 0.5 m, so it shows past the house's corner as the print's narrow dark strip (x 225-247 px) under its cornice's end, with nothing at full height beyond it where the print shows 2115's mansard; the east part held to the same line
the dormer's surround (T-3666 sign-off): an eared hood round its round head, as 2115's from the same photograph, about 1.66 m across against the print's 1.5 m
the frieze's long sunk panel and lozenge and the carved pilaster strip on the front's south corner are not laid; each is under about 0.3 m of relief and depth
the mansard's rise: the render's face stands a little taller than the print's to the deck cornice
colour: the print is monochrome; the stone's pale tone agrees with the render's Lemont limestone, the flanks' brick is unseen
the front north of the south bay, the door, the steps to the veranda, the north flank and the rear: out of the print's frame

the south run's receding columns: four, as the print's, but its last two stand 25-50 px left of the render's (x 397 and 350 against about 424 and 400) along a run seen almost end-on, where the camera's distance (uncertain by about 15%) sets their spacing, and the sheet ends the veranda at the rear block

the dormer's carving: the ears' scrolls, the consoles at its foot and the keystone at its crown are under 0.3 m of relief; the print's light is two-light with a mullion where the render's carries a fanlight

the veranda's pedestals and piers are panelled in the print and plain in the render (under 0.05 m of relief); the deck's railing between the south run's pedestals reads dark (iron) in the print and is the porch's stone in the render, within a monochrome print's tone
the rear block's roof: the print shows a slated slope over its bracketed cornice's end (x 225-283, y 473-517 px); the render's flat deck shows a plain fascia there, about 0.5 m of it in view
